import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0
    # Columns: ['right_index', '0']
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Rename '0' to '0_x'
    df0 = df0.rename(columns={'0': '0_x'})

    # Load Source 1
    # Columns: ['0']
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Rename '0' to '0_y'
    df1 = df1.rename(columns={'0': '0_y'})

    # Join Source 0 and Source 1 on df0.right_index == df1.index
    # Ensure df1 index is default integer index
    df1 = df1.reset_index(drop=True)

    # Merge on df0.right_index and df1.index
    # Since df1 index is not a column, we can merge by left_on='right_index', right_index=True
    df_merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, left_on='right_index', right_index=True, how='inner')

    # Select only the columns ['0_x', '0_y']
    df_target = df_merged[['0_x', '0_y']]

    # Convert columns to float explicitly (if not already)
    df_target = df_target.astype({'0_x': float, '0_y': float})

    # Save to CSV without index
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
